fields.Front: List the four CS3307A assessments with weight and due date.
fields.Back: Project Proposal 20% (Tue. Oct. 6); Intermediate Design + Partial Implementation 30% (Tue. Nov. 10); Final Project Submission 30% (Tue. Dec. 8); Final Examination 20% (Registrar-scheduled Dec. 11-22). All project deadlines are 11:59 PM.

fields.Front: What must each of the three project deliverables contain?
fields.Back: D1 Proposal: problem statement, system features, design approach, initial UML class diagram. D2 Intermediate: complete UML diagrams, use case descriptions, partial C++ implementation, design rationale document. D3 Final: complete system implementation, final UML diagrams, comprehensive documentation and test suite.

fields.Front: What is the final exam format, and what is the generative-AI policy?
fields.Back: Mix of multiple-choice, short answer, and problem-solving, emphasising 'lots and lots of refactoring' and writing code by hand. Generative AI is permitted with disclosure for project work but strictly prohibited on the final exam. Testing uses GoogleTest and Google Mock.

fields.Text: The project is worth {{c1::80%}}, is done in {{c1::pairs of two students}}, has an automatic {{c1::48-hour}} no-late-penalty window, and UML must be submitted as {{c1::PDF}} via Brightspace and GitHub.
fields.Extra: The 48-hour window is not a replacement due date; after it closes you need approved Academic Consideration.
